notes: The vector leg, scored as recall@k rather than as an exact set: ranking by cosine similarity is not a filter, and demanding an exact answer from it would be measuring the wrong thing. Each case is a vibe the router would send to VECTOR (free_text, no structured constraint), with the events a person would expect near the top. `expect` is what must appear inside the top k; `forbidden` is what must not appear at all, which is where the threshold earns its keep - a vector search with nothing close enough should return nothing rather than the least-bad thing in the graph.

test_cases.free_text: somewhere small and intimate, just a voice and a guitar
test_cases.why: one singer with a guitar, in the fixture's own words

test_cases.free_text: a loud dark warehouse with hard techno until morning
test_cases.why: industrial techno in a big dark room is the obvious one; the hard-and-fast club night is the second

test_cases.free_text: candle-lit jazz piano, quiet enough to talk over
test_cases.why: the candle-lit piano trio - the case the roadmap uses as its example of a vibe ask

test_cases.free_text: a silent disco on a boat with a comedy open mic
test_cases.why: nothing in the fixture is this, so the similarity threshold should return nothing rather than the nearest gig
